verdict.rationale: Recurly's own RevRec product is documented as automating ASC 606 and IFRS 15 revenue recognition, and Recurly's export docs list revenue recognition among the reports available from billing data. The evidence does not detail deferred revenue schedules or audit-ready reporting. missing for 10: explicit documentation of deferred revenue schedules, audit-ready recognition report details, evidence of how RevRec draws directly on Recurly billing data, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data

citations.quote: Recurly RevRec automates revenue recognition for ASC 606, IFRS 15/16, ASC 842, and ASC 340-40 compliance
export detailed reports across your business — from customer records and subscriptions to invoices, coupons, transactions, and revenue recognition.
